name: Status Pages
description: Handle status/maintenance pages across different environments.
project_description:
This module provides routes and templates for 403 and 404 status pages as well as settings for the texts so that you don't need to set a node ID in the basic site settings and can provide paths ( /page-403 /page-404 ) instead that exist on all your environments without the need of creating content for it and keeping it in sync across your environments.

 Features 
 
 Provides routes/paths for 403 and 404 pages 
 Provides a settings page to configure texts for the status pages 
 Provides templates for the status pages to keep them in the same style 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Once enabled configure the texts for your status pages on /admin/config/system/status-pages-settings and make sure the paths /page-403 /page-404 are set on /admin/config/system/site-information .
